subject: HelixData pilot gating & champion enablement — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@helixdata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@helixdata.com>, Marcus Hill <mh@helixdata.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow post-demo: pilot gating & security inputs

Marissa — thanks for the demo earlier. High level notes and asks from our side: 

- We liked the latency and ability to pin a model variant per route; procurement and finance will want an ROI sketch.
- Security (Marcus) flagged two items: SOC 2 scope for inference logs and key management (KMS integration). Marcus also asked for a short list of evidence we can hand off to our InfoSec review team.
- Procurement (Priya) wants a rough timeline for pilot procurement (SOW/PO cadence) and a mutual action plan (MAP) she can take to suppliers.

Can you send a concise MAP we can use with internal stakeholders (expect to include finance + legal + security)? Also, any slide or 1-pager with forecasted token cost assumptions for a 3-month pilot would help.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Liu
Director of Data Platforms, HelixData
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@helixdata.com>, Priya Rao <prao@helixdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow post-demo: pilot gating & security inputs

Jordan — appreciate the clear asks. Short recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Recap (from demo):
- Scope: 8k-context LLM for document question-answering (internal data only)
- Target SLO: 95th pct latency < 220ms for short completions, throughput 150 req/s during business hours
- Pilot length proposal: 8 weeks (production-like staging + 2-week ramp)

Immediate deliverables (I will attach MAP draft and security checklist):
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached: HelixData-MAP_v1.xlsx) — includes milestones, owner assignments (Finance, Security, Procurement, Eng), and gating criteria.
2) Security evidence bundle (short checklist + sample SOC 2 control mapping) — high level items: audit logs retention policy, KMS integration options (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / BYOK), data-in-transit encryption, and access controls.
3) Pilot cost estimate — I’ll include token-cost scenarios in the MAP tab.

Proposed timing: 
- Oct 22: Internal Helix review of MAP (Priya + Marcus + Finance)
- Oct 26: Redwood to deliver updated MAP + 1-page ROI (Marissa + Ben)
- Nov 2: Finalize SOW and procurement path to accept pilot (if gating OK)

Questions for you (so we can tailor the MAP):
- Who is the final economic approver for pilots — is that Priya or someone in Finance leadership?
- Marcus, is there a preferred encryption key workflow (BYOK vs managed KMS) or evidence format that accelerates review?

Next step: I’ll upload the MAP draft and an abridged security checklist now — Ben and Kimberly are looped to help with ROI and contract cadence.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: HelixData-MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92KB)
From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@helixdata.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@helixdata.com>, Marcus Hill <mh@helixdata.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T19:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow post-demo: pilot gating & security inputs

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications inline: 

> Proposed timing:
> - Oct 22: Internal Helix review of MAP (Priya + Marcus + Finance)

That works for our timeline. Priya confirms she’ll circulate the MAP to Finance; final economic approver will likely be Suresh Patel (VP Finance). I’ll loop him if the numbers look right.

> Marcus, is there a preferred encryption key workflow (BYOK vs managed KMS)

Marcus: we prefer BYOK for anything tied to customer data; if Redwood can outline the BYOK integration surface (minimal steps to rotate keys, evidence of KMS client libraries used) that would be great. Marcus also asked for a short extract of the logging schema (fields and retention) so his team can confirm no PII leakage.

One more thing: can you add a short "talk track" paragraph in the MAP for our internal champion to use at exec briefing (3 bullets: cost savings, reliability guarantees, timeline ask)? That will help us socialize quickly.

Appreciate the speed — Jordan

Date: 2026-10-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow post-demo: pilot gating & security inputs — pilot economics + SOW cadence

Jordan / Marissa — adding a couple of pilot economics and procurement readiness notes from finance side: 

- Pilot pricing: we typically offer a 30% pilot discount on usage for first 8 weeks and a capped token-cost estimate in the SOW. For planning, I put three scenarios in the MAP (low/med/high).
- SOW cadence: we can issue a pilot SOW (no-cost eval except usage) and accept PO on signature; if Helix needs PO-first we can accept a short-term prepayment.
- SLA/ops: attached a short SLA-draft that covers uptime targets and a rollback/fallback policy. This is standard for dedicated pilots and can be tightened for Dedicated capacity.

Next step from us: Marissa + I will update MAP with the three pricing scenarios and add the 3-bullet champion talk track Jordan requested. Expect v2 by Oct 26.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attach: SLA-draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
